Sofia (CS): Flagging an urgent note from SilverLine's onboarding call — three product issues surfaced that could delay their go-live. Posting for triage.
Alex (CS): Parsed asks: 1) export filtering by status+region, 2) export run time under 120s for daily full-run (~12k rows), 3) delivery guarantees for webhooks (dedupe headers or idempotency).
Rory (Support): They triggered duplicates when retry logic overlapped with retries from the partner ETL. See ticket S-4199 for traces and DB duplicate examples.
Mina (Onboarding): SilverLine said "auditors will not accept duplicates" and asked for a mitigation plan this week. Their largest daily export ~12k rows, peak payload ~4.2MB.
Diego (PM): Let's score quickly: Impact (H/M/L), Effort (S/M/L), RenewalRisk (Y/N). Also need sample export schema & which fields to use for dedupe keys.
Sofia (CS): Quick CS votes: filtered exports = H / M / Y; export perf = H / L / Y; webhook dedupe = M / S / Y.
Alex (CS): Customer quote: "If exports contain duplicates or take >2 minutes we can't close our validation — it's a blocker."
Diego (PM): I'll own export perf spike. Plan: run a PoC with streaming + incremental writes, 48h spike, aim to measure median & p95. Will create RDW-4607 (exports) and RDW-4608 (webhook dedupe).
Rory (Support): Attaching S-4199 logs to RDW-4608 once created. Also capturing the duplicate payload IDs.
Mina (Onboarding): I'll request their full export sample and the partner ETL retry behavior doc.
redwoodbot: Reminder: include customer reference and attach onboarding notes when filing tickets.
Sofia (CS): Action items: 1) Mina get samples + ETL behavior, 2) Diego create tickets + run spike, 3) Rory attach logs, 4) Alex flag renewal-risk in tracker.
Diego (PM): Spike starts Mon; expect write-up + perf numbers by Wed EOD. If PoC shows we can get <120s with streaming + dedupe hints, we'll scope engineering work next sprint.
Alex (CS): Scheduling a quick sync Friday 9:30 to update SilverLine. :calendar: 
Sofia (CS): Closing loop here  I'll update the feedback tracker and mark exports as renewal risk. :white_check_mark:
